history.title: History
history.text: Subaru traces its roots to the Aircraft Research Laboratory founded by Chikuhei Nakajima in 1917, which later became Nakajima Aircraft. After a series of reorganizations, Fuji Heavy Industries was established in 1953 and began building Subaru vehicles with the Subaru 360 in 1958. In 2017 the company was renamed Subaru Corporation. "Subaru" is the Japanese name for the Pleiades star cluster ("Mutsuraboshi", the six stars), symbolizing the unity of six companies.

global.title: Global position
global.text: Subaru is a Japanese automotive and aerospace brand trusted by customers worldwide. Cumulative AWD production reached 20 million units in 2021, and cumulative global sales of EyeSight-equipped vehicles reached 5 million units in 2022.

items.name: SGP chassis

history.lead: We started in 2015 as a small project of about 15 people. Today the division operates with 550 people across 2 offices.

timeline.text: Started annotation work with a 15-person project.
Scaled up to 50 people, working on tagging data.
Recognition data for Japan's railway system. Grew to 150 people.
Received first 3D data orders and began segmentation data. Launched a policy to send staff to Japan to study and work.
Began Bounding Box and satellite data. Grew to 200 people.
Developed 3D Bounding Box. Grew to 550 people.

process.title: Operating flow
process.lead: How BPO BRYCEN VIETNAM and the customer work together, from the first request to final acceptance.

steps.text: BPO BRYCEN VN receives the request and trial-measures volume and difficulty.
The customer places the order; BPO BRYCEN VN accepts it.
Set up the team, work environment, kickoff and training.
Carry out the work with multi-layer quality inspection.
Interim delivery; the customer inspects and sends feedback (FB), and BPO adjusts.
Final delivery; the customer accepts the work.
